title: Explicit locations
description: The exact points to target, each on a named neuron. Click anywhere on a neuron in the 3D view to add one, or type it in by hand. Each row is a single point: which neuron it belongs to, which branch of that neuron it sits on, and how far along that branch it is — 0 is the start of the branch, 1 is the end, 0.5 is halfway. Branch 0 is always the soma. At least one point is required.
